title: Add Quickstart Templates troubleshooting page (common errors + fixes)
author: Wei Chen
description: This PR adds a dedicated troubleshooting page for Quickstart Templates and links it from the templates walkthrough. The goal is to reduce “first run” friction during internal beta / early public launch by giving copy-pastable remediation steps for the most common issues we’ve seen in #help and support tickets: 401 auth failures, 429 rate limits, timeouts/streaming disconnects behind proxies, tool schema validation errors, and retrieval returning empty/low-quality results. Scope: (1) New docs page: “Troubleshooting & Common Errors” with an error taxonomy-style layout (symptom → likely causes → what to check → fixes → what to include in a support ticket). (2) Standardizes wording across Python + TypeScript templates (uses the same names as template error types and log fields). (3) Adds a short section on observability verification so users can confirm traces/metrics/logs are flowing before escalating. Notes/constraints: We intentionally keep telemetry tagging guidance opt-in and mention that some corporate proxies reject unknown headers (see SUP-29458). We also call out redaction expectations (don’t paste prompts or secrets into tickets) and what identifiers are safe (Redwood-Request-Id, trace_id). Testing: `pnpm lint` + `pnpm build` locally; previewed in docs dev server; links validated. Follow-ups: If/when ENG-4189 lands request-id propagation improvements in SDKs, we should update the “What to provide Support” section to include the exact header name surfaced by each SDK.
commits: docs(quickstarts): add troubleshooting page for template common failures
docs: add error-specific remediation steps for 401/429/timeouts
docs: add tool schema + retrieval empty results sections
docs: link troubleshooting from RAG+Agents template walkthrough
conversation: Elliot Price (review): This is in the right direction. Two requests: (1) make the section headers match what people search for in support (e.g., “401 Unauthorized” not “Auth error”), and (2) add a short “What to include when contacting Support” callout with request id + trace id and a reminder to redact prompts/PII. Also: can we keep it consistent with the error taxonomy draft? Wei Chen (author): Ack. I’ll rename headers and add a support callout. I’ll also cross-check with the taxonomy names used in templates (network/auth/quota/tool/retrieval) so the terms match what users see in logs. Monica Patel (review): Please explicitly mention that `REDWOOD_API_KEY` must be set in the shell environment running the server (we’ve seen folks set it in one terminal and run in another). Also add the “wrong base URL / region” failure mode for 401 in case they’re on a VPC endpoint. Wei Chen: Added checks for env var scope + base URL mismatch and clarified hosted vs private endpoints at a high level (without going deep into deployment docs). Priya Shah (review): Love the “symptom → fix” format. For 429, can we include the exact guidance we’ve been giving in SUP-29435: lower concurrency, reduce max_tokens, and increase backoff w/ jitter; also mention that retries can amplify rate limiting if misconfigured. Wei Chen: Added a 429 section with concrete knobs and a warning about retry storms; linked to template safe defaults section. Christine Wong (review): For timeouts/streaming disconnects: add a note about proxies/load balancers that buffer responses or terminate idle connections; recommend enabling TCP keepalives where applicable and confirm client-side timeout > server keepalive. Also include a “try non-streaming to isolate” tip. Wei Chen: Added proxy buffering + idle timeout notes and a quick isolation checklist (non-streaming, curl test, bypass proxy if possible). Christine Wong (follow-up): Please avoid prescribing specific proxy configs (nginx) since we don’t want to own that; keep it general. Wei Chen: Done; generalized and removed nginx-specific directives. Elliot Price (final review): Can we add anchors so we can deep-link from support macros? Wei Chen: Added per-error anchors and a short “copy link” hint. Approved. CI: Initial build failed due to broken relative link to observability explainer; fixed by using absolute docs path and reran checks. Merge: Squashed.
release_notes: Docs: Added “Troubleshooting & Common Errors” for Quickstart Templates covering 401/429/timeouts/streaming disconnects/tool schema errors/retrieval empty results, plus guidance on what to include in support requests and how to verify observability is working.
